scenes.headline: How one pixel diffusion model runs at any token budget
scenes.sub: Merge the flat patches, and read the layout off a draft.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Quadra! This paper teaches one pixel diffusion model to run at any token budget. Here's how.

scenes.text: Merge flat regions into bigger patches by their entropy, and at sampling time read the layout off the model's own first draft.
scenes.say: Flat regions merge into bigger patches. With no image yet when sampling starts, the layout is read off the model's own first draft.

scenes.title: The entropy quadtree
scenes.say: The layout comes from one rule.

items.text: Cut the image into big cells
items.say: Start with big cells, sixty-four pixels a side.
Measure each cell's entropy: how spread out its brightness is.
A flat cell, like plain sky, stays one token.
A busy cell splits in four, and each quarter faces the same test.
One offset shifts every threshold until the layout fits the budget.

steps.say: The noisy image arrives with a layout: which patches stay small, and which merge.
The encoder embeds each big patch twice, shrunk and in pieces, and mixes them into one token.
The pretrained transformer runs on the shorter sequence.
The decoder scales each big token back up, and a small refiner adds back texture, giving a clean estimate.
That estimate is where the next layout comes from. The model reads its own draft.
With no warm-up, the first layout is read off a blur.
After five dense steps, the draft already shows where the detail is.
With the warm-up, only a small share of the layout ever changes.

scenes.title: Speed-up at a quarter of the tokens
scenes.note: one H100, measured by the authors
scenes.say: At a quarter of the tokens, the authors measure three and a half times faster on their biggest text model, and under two times elsewhere.

scenes.text: Merged tokens only need a rough layout, and a few dense steps give a draft good enough to place them.
scenes.say: Merged tokens only need a rough layout. A few dense steps give a draft good enough to place them.

recap: Encoder and refiner bridge the sizes
scenes.say: Entropy picks what merges, two small modules bridge the sizes, and the draft sets the layout.
